explication: PST is a Palworld dedicated-server management tool with a Go REST backend, Vue desktop/mobile interface, and Python save parser. The main workflow is: an administrator configures a save source and server connections, PST retrieves and parses saves, the UI/API exposes player and guild data, and administrators manage the game server and scheduled work. The README documents backups, whitelist, RCON automation, map views, and responsive UI; some corresponding source was not sampled, so those links are documented rather than source-verified.
